boundaries: This check proves that the named public pages loaded at the checked time; it does not prove search indexing, traffic, player satisfaction or uptime outside the check.
One game canvas after five seconds proves that the game entry started; it does not prove every scene, device or complete playthrough.
The story check proves its page, six real-game realm images, play link and sitemap entry were reachable; the unapproved trailer remains unlinked.
The Signal Log check proves its page, four named release notes, homepage link and sitemap entry were reachable; it does not prove that anyone read or acted on them.

The homepage check proves that two user-controlled share actions and the clean mythicalvoid.com destination were in the live storefront bundle; it does not prove that anyone shared the game or that a recipient opened it.
The press-room check proves that two Project Beacon social images were linked and served as PNG files; it does not prove that either was posted to an official social account or seen by an audience.
Prepared distribution and outreach work remains internal and unsubmitted.
